newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HIV cases jump 10 percent in Hong Kong in 1996.
newsitem.headline: HIV cases jump 10 percent in Hong Kong in 1996.

text.p: The number of people with the virus that causes AIDS jumped nearly 10 percent in Hong Kong last year, the governmment said on Tuesday.
Health department figures showed 134 people were found to be infected with the HIV virus in 1996, which causes Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome, up 9.8 percent from 1995.
The department said this brought the total number of people infected with HIV in Hong Kong to 776 since data gathering began in 1984. Hong Kong has a population of 6.3 million.
